sentences.text:
Baskar Reddy Kannareddy Kanreddy ... vs The State Of
Telangana on 7 February, 2025

Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 The Honourable Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 Criminal Petition No.1721 of 2025
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner-accused seeking to quash the proceedings against him in FIR No.7 of 2025 of PS Kodair, Nagarkurnool District, registered for the offences under Sections 420 and 406 of IPC.
02.

Heard Sri C.Sharan Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Jithender Rao Veeramalla,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

03. Though this petition is filed for quashing the proceedings in the crime, during the course of arguments, learned counsel for the petitioner has sought for directions to the Police to proceed with investigation by issuing notice under Section 35(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (for short 'BNSS') (Previously Section 41-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure).
04.

In view of the above, without going into merits of the matter, this Criminal Petition is disposed of directing the Police concerned to proceed with the investigation in the above crime after issuing notice under Section 35(3) of the BNSS (Previously Section 41-A of Cr.P.C.) to the petitioner-accused and the Investigating Officer shall also follow the guidelines formulated by the Honourable Supreme Court in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar and another 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
However,
the petitioner-accused shall submit his defense and co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
05. With the above directions, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
